initiatives.name: Initiatives
initiatives.description: The initiatives drawn as bars. Each row needs a Plan date range; its KPI impact comes from the Impacts database. Every property of this database can be used in the block's filter bar.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Planned window (a date range). A single date plans the whole month it falls in.

start.name: Started
start.description: Actual start, when it differs from the plan.

done.name: Done
done.description: Actual finish date. Set once the initiative is complete.

timing.name: If off plan
timing.description: 'Timeline moves' (impact is kept, the end date slips) or 'Impact changes' (the date is fixed, the impact shrinks or grows). Empty uses the block default.

kpis.name: KPIs
kpis.description: Optional details for the KPIs named in the Impacts database: unit, baseline, direction and goal. Matched by relation, or by title when Impacts names KPIs with a select or multi-select.

baseline.name: Baseline
baseline.description: The KPI's value before the first initiative.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: 'Increase' or 'Decrease' (burndown KPIs such as churn or cost, where initiatives have negative impact).

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: Target value. Empty uses the total of the plan.

goalBy.name: Goal by
goalBy.description: When the goal should be reached.

range.name: Range ±
range.description: Uncertainty of the projection as a fraction (0.3 = ±30%). Empty uses 0.3.

impacts.name: Impacts
impacts.description: One row per initiative and KPI it moves: the planned change and what it has achieved so far.

kpi.name: KPI
kpi.description: Relation to the KPI. The block's settings can instead use any select or multi-select column of this database as the KPI.

planned.name: Planned
planned.description: Planned change of the KPI (negative for burndown KPIs).
